firm_data.firm_description: Akerman LLP is an Am Law 100 firm with more than 700 lawyers across the United States, providing legal advocacy and guidance for industries from technology to construction. The firm delivers results across a range of practice areas and is known for its culture of innovation.
notable_facts: Akerman posted record revenue of $627M in 2025.
Akerman was named 'Law Firm of the Year' for Leveraged Buyouts and Private Equity Law by Best Lawyers' 2026 'Best Law Firms' Guide.
Akerman ranks among PitchBook's Top Busiest Law Firms in M&A, PE.
Akerman is named among Vault Law’s 100 Most Prestigious Law Firms.
technology_signals: Akerman and USC Gould School of Law launch flagship Law+AI Initiative to bridge legal scholarship and commercial innovation.

ai_contact.ai_notes: Akerman and USC Gould School of Law launched a Law+AI Initiative.

email.subject: AI for Akerman — scaling legal ops across 700+ lawyers
email.body:
Hi Azfar,

I noticed Akerman just launched the Law+AI Initiative with USC Gould and posted record $627M revenue—you're clearly moving fast on both innovation and growth. Managing tech infrastructure across 700+ lawyers and 11 practice areas while staying competitive on AI is exactly the challenge we solve.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms navigating BigLaw-scale demands. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and operational efficiency that actually scale.

Given Akerman's AI ambitions and your ops complexity, I'd love to show you how we're helping similar firms automate the right work—without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
